name: Park Hyatt Hangzhou
positioning: High-rise hotel in the MixC complex near the Qianjiang New Central Business District, with Qiantang River views and dining on levels 37 and 48
best_for: Travelers who want a base beside the MixC Mall near the Qianjiang business district
Guests who want river views, afternoon tea and a rooftop-style bar with live music

facts.text: The hotel sits in the MixC complex, close to the Qianjiang New Central Business District.
The MixC Mall is just downstairs from the hotel.
Bathrooms have twin vanities, rain showers, deep-soaking bathtubs and a separate automatic washlet.
Each room includes a walk-in closet and custom-made furniture and art.
The Park Executive Suite has a private balcony overlooking the Qiantang River.
The Living Room serves a signature afternoon tea with individually served savouries and a dessert trolley.
The Dining Room serves local Zhejiang and Cantonese cuisines made with seasonal ingredients.
Forty8 Bar opens onto a large outdoor garden terrace with lounge seating, a movie screen and views of the Hangzhou skyline.
Forty8 Restaurant on level 48 is styled like a gourmet marketplace with open kitchens specializing in fresh seafood, grilled meats, and regional Chinese and Western cuisines.
The hotel has more than 1,900 square meters of event space.
The hotel offers on-site parking to hotel and restaurant guests.
Metro lines 2 and 4 are listed as ways of getting around from the hotel.

highlights.text: The Ledge at Forty8 is a glass-floored architectural feature extending over the edge of the building.
The Living Room on level 37 wraps around the lobby with 270-degree panoramic views of the city and Qiantang River.
The Dining Room is decorated with large glass lanterns and silk panels hand-embroidered by Suzhou artisans.
The rooms were planned by designer Yabu Pushelberg and feature high ceilings with views of the Qiantang River or the Qianjiang New Central Business District.
Forty8 Bar has a cocktail bar, a whisky bar and a music room with a stage for live music.

considerations.text: The hotel is in a business-district setting, in the MixC complex near the Qianjiang New Central Business District.
Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport is 31 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in mainland China.
